purpose: Define public Project ranking and broker relevance as derived policy views over Project and Merit outcomes rather than new leaderboard or global weighting primitives.

owns: Public Project Ranking and Relevance semantics

topics.name: Project Ranking
topics.purpose: Define public Project ranking and broker relevance as derived policy views over Project and Merit outcomes rather than new leaderboard or global weighting primitives.

semantics.ranking_rule: Public Projects may be ranked using AIGM 1337 / explicit ranking policy based on Merit outcomes and Project evidence.
semantics.no_leaderboard_primitive_rule: There is no separate canonical leaderboard primitive solely for ranking display.
semantics.relevance_rule: Broker relevance is explicit contextual policy, not a global universal weighting baked into MeritCore.
semantics.projection_rule: Rankings are derived projections and do not mutate underlying Project/Merit semantics.
semantics.public_rule: Only explicitly public/eligible Project data participates in public ranking.
semantics.policy_provenance_rule: Ranking/relevance results retain policy and source provenance.

invariants.rule: Project/task, execution, evidence and merit semantics are explicit and non-duplicated.

hard_gates.condition: ranking projection becomes new source of truth
private/ineligible Project data enters public ranking without explicit permission
global relevance weighting silently embedded into MeritCore
separate leaderboard primitive duplicates ranking projection semantics

prose.summary: Define public Project ranking and broker relevance as derived policy views over Project and Merit outcomes rather than new leaderboard or global weighting primitives.
